Chapter 145.
Business Names Regulation 1964
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS.
1. Forms.
2. Particulars prescribed by forms.

3. Directions in forms.
4. General requirements for documents lodged with Registrar.
5. Application for consent to registration of business name.
6. Fees.
Business Names Regulation 1964
MADE under the Business Names Act 1963.
Dated 200 .
1. FORMS.
Where a provision of the Act is specified in the first column of Schedule 1, the form in
Schedule 2 that is specified in the third column of Schedule 1 in relation to the provision
is the form to be used for the purposes of the provision described in the second column of
Schedule 1.
2. PARTICULARS PRESCRIBED BY FORMS.
Where a form prescribed by this Regulation requires completion by the insertion of, or
the attachment to the form of a document containing, particulars or other matters referred
to in the form, those particulars or other matters are prescribed as the particulars or other
matters required under the provision of the Act for the purposes of which the form is
prescribed.

3. DIRECTIONS IN FORMS.
A form prescribed by this Regulation shall be completed in accordance with such
directions as are specified in the form.
4. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS FOR DOCUMENTS LODGED WITH REGISTRAR.
A document to be lodged with the Registrar under the Act or this Regulation shall
comply with the following requirements:–
(a) the document shall be on paper of medium weight and good quality and of
International A4 size; and
(b) the document shall be printed or handwritten and shall be clearly legible; and
(c) the document shall not be a carbon copy; and
(d) where the document comprises two or more sheets, the sheets shall be bound together
securely; and
(e) the document shall have endorsed–
(i) on the upper right-hand corner–the registered number (if any) allotted by the Registrar
to the business name to which the document relates; and
(ii) the name, postal address and telephone number of the lawyer or other person by, or
on whose behalf, the document is lodged; and
(iii) the following words–
“Lodged in the office of the Registrar of Companies on . . . 20...
“Registrar of Companies.”
5. APPLICATION FOR CONSENT TO REGISTRATION OF BUSINESS NAME.
An application under Section 10 of the Act for the consent of the Minister shall be lodged
with the Registrar.

6. FEES.
(1) The fees specified in the third column of Schedule 3 shall be paid to the Registrar in
respect of the respective matters in the second column of that Schedule.
(2) Where the Minister gives his consent to the use of a business name the fee paid by an
applicant for the consent shall be repaid to the applicant.
